option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathological findings match the characteristics of Eruptive Pruritic Papular Porokeratosis (EPPP).
The clinical presentation and histopathological findings do not match the characteristics of Disseminated Superficial Actinic Porokeratosis (DSAP).
The clinical presentation and histopathological findings do not match the characteristics of Linear Porokeratosis.
The clinical presentation and histopathological findings do not match the characteristics of Disseminated Superficial Porokeratosis (DSP).
